title: Hard: draggable parameter drives tick + linked chart.line
prompt: Create an interactive lab world: (1) a data-backed knob node the user can drag horizontally, writing __event.x back into a parameter field; (2) a tick that evolves a numeric series from that parameter; (3) a top-level chart.line bound to that series. Do not copy toy counter demos. Output ONLY Viva source starting with artifact.
